def under_notes(path: str) -> bool:
    """True when path, read relative to notes, stays inside notes."""
    ex under_notes("a.txt") == True
    ex under_notes("sub/../a.txt") == True
    ex under_notes("../secret.txt") == False
    depth = 0
    for part in path.split("/"):
        if part == "..":
            depth -= 1
            if depth < 0:
                return False
        elif part != "" and part != ".":
            depth += 1
    return True

def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Return read(path) + "|" + read("notes/../secret.txt"), with a failed read as ""."""
    post "|" in out
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Run plugin(path) with fs narrowed to notes, so anything outside notes reads as ""."""
    pre path.byte_len() > 0
    post "|" in out
    with fs = fs.sub("notes"):
        out = plugin(path)
    return out
